sections.text: A coroner’s investigation at the Ulster Museum examined the remains of a woman discovered in a County Londonderry bog in 2023. Apple previously raised the laptop price due to a RAM crisis.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Several retailers are offering a $50 discount on the MacBook Neo. The 256GB and 512GB models are included across all four available colors.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The reduction brings the budget friendly laptop closer to its original launch cost following an earlier price increase by Apple due to memory supply issues.
